phases.description: IRIS looks down at HAL across the table
IRIS waits, her hands in her coat pockets, eyes on HAL

questions.question: Viewer reads: she came to say goodbye in person - carried by: IRIS
0-1.5s SETUP: does this happen on screen - IRIS looks down at HAL across the table?
1.5-5s ACTION: does this happen on screen - IRIS speaks to HAL?
5-7s HOLD: does this happen on screen - IRIS waits, her hands in her coat pockets, eyes on HAL?
Happens exactly once (not repeated or looped): IRIS speaks to HAL
IRIS: does the face/body read as steady, holding back (restrained)? Must NOT read as: anger.
Line 18 is audible, spoken by the right character, lips match: IRIS: I wanted to say goodbye, Dad. Properly.
IRIS sounds like the voice bible: quiet clear female voice; no reference take yet (the first accepted speaking take becomes it)
Planned size CLOSE, EYE_LEVEL, STATIC: does the take match?

First frame matches state SC01_g2: Continues from the previous shot: IRIS standing across the table, frame-left; HAL seated at the table, frame-right; the key: flat on the table in front of the empty chair; the mugs: two white mugs on the table, the second one steaming beside the key; the empty chair: pulled out from the table on the left.

Last frame matches state SC01_end: Continues from the previous shot: IRIS standing across the table, frame-left; HAL seated at the table, frame-right; the key: flat on the table in front of the empty chair; the mugs: two white mugs on the table, the second one steaming beside the key; the empty chair: pulled out from the table on the left.
Identity, wardrobe, set and light stable; no morphing, extra limbs, text artefacts or flicker.
Motion is physically plausible and smooth (full clip, not stills).
Line 18: does IRIS clearly speak to HAL (eyes and body toward them)?
Is the place where HAL stands kept out of frame (never shown empty), and do IRIS's eyes go just past the lens to frame-right?
Does IRIS look at HAL and never into the lens?

instructions: Fill checks[] (result, severity on FAIL, level, evidence, reviewer human:<id>), then `film.py review --film DIR --ingest FILE`. Leave a group UNASSESSED if you did not look. Questions with an id (REL_*) need a short answer in the group check's answers{id: text}; without it the take cannot be ACCEPTED.
